newsitem.title: USA: Physician says adopts shareholder rights.
newsitem.headline: Physician says adopts shareholder rights.

text.p: Physician Reliance Network Inc said Tuesday that it adopted a shareholder rights plan.
Holders of Physician Reliance common stock as of June 16 will receive preferred stock purchase rights as a dividend at the rate of one right for each share of common stock.
The rights will expire on June 2, 2007, the company said.
The plan was not adopted in response to any specific attempt to acquire control of the company and the company said it is not aware of any such effort.
The company said each right will become exercisable upon a person's or group's acquisition of, or commencement of a tender or exchange offer for, 18 percent or more of the company's common stock.

The company said rights will also become exercisable if a shareholder of the company holding at least 10 percent of its shares is deemed to be an "adverse person," or in the event of certain mergers or asset sales involving more than 50 percent of the company's assets or earning power.
